item.description:

  • feat(forecast): monthly tournament roster + day-of-week candidate by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#54
  • feat(forecast): BurnTrajectory — curve-fit tournament for rate-limit forward curves by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#55

  • feat(dashboard): "Compare models" projection detail view by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#57
  • feat(forecast): completed-cycle scoring + scoreboard (feedback-loop foundation) by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#58
  • feat(intelligence): forecast-engine primitives — Estimate, conformal intervals, EB shrinkage by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#59
  • feat(intelligence): unified walk-forward harness — per-regime scoring + bootstrap CIs by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#60
  • feat(intelligence): regime-gated end-of-day projector (weekday shape + conformal bands) by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#61
  • feat(intelligence): diurnal 7d burn model — integrate a weekday×hour rate forward by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#62
  • feat(intelligence): usage norms — typical-range bands, anomaly, pace-vs-norm by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#63
  • feat(intelligence): monthly daily-sum projector — fixes the demotion problem by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#64
  • feat(intelligence): engine actor — owns the store, typed question→Estimate API by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#65
  • feat(intelligence): self-eval persistence — the engine learns from its own track record by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#66
  • feat(intelligence): extend the self-eval loop to the rate-limit outlook by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#67
  • refactor(intelligence): the engine becomes the app's single prediction authority by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#68
  • feat(intelligence): research-driven model upgrades — pickup, pooling, remainder-conformal, stratified RL bands by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#69
  • feat(ui): final intelligence surface — research-backed uncertainty presentation by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#70
  • perf(intelligence): 2.8x faster refits + the engine reference doc by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#71
  • feat(ui): dissolve the intelligence card — engine answers live in the existing surfaces by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#72
  • feat(ui): trajectory + outlook polish across every surface by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#73
  • feat(ui): numbers with referents, labeled range bars, sheet redo, smarter burn warnings by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#74
  • feat(ui): self-explanatory units everywhere — clarity round 3 by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#75
  • fix(ui): round 4 — failure-case rendering, consistent selection metric, fold recovery by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#76
  • feat(ui): round 5 — honest crossing ranges, house modal for compare, header badges by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#77
  • fix(ui): plain-language burn copy — "limit" not "cap", outcomes not ratios, charts end at 100% by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#79
  • feat(ui): dashboard redesign — Now/Today strip, verdict chips on the wide charts, month outlook in trends by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#80
  • chore: post-redesign cleanup — stale names, file rename, fresh screenshots by @EricAndrechek in EricAndrechek/Pacer#81
